name: EPIC 211123165
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 13.8 solar radii and 1.77 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211123165 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.795543 (16th-84th percentiles 13.260813-14.20922), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211123165 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4217.109375 (16th-84th percentiles 4145.507812-4288.125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.35 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,217 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.77 solar masses and 13.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,789 K at its surface.
